40020565.author: पदार्थः
40020565.content: प्रविष्टायां having entered, हुताशं fire, तु indeed, वेदवत्यां Vedavati, सः he, रावणः Ravana, पुष्पकं Pushpaka (chariot), तु indeed, समारुह्य having ascended, परिचक्राम wandered around, मेदिनीम् the earth.

40020565.author: Translation
40020565.content: After Vedavati entered the fire, Ravana ascended his Pushpaka chariot and wandered across the earth.

40020566.author: पदार्थः
40020566.content: ततः then, मरुत्तं Marutta, नृपतिं king, यजन्तं sacrificing, सह with, दैवतैः deities, उशीरबीजम् Ushirabija (a place), आसाद्य having reached, ददर्श saw, सः he, तु indeed, रावणः Ravana.

40020566.author: Translation
40020566.content: Then, having arrived at Ushirabija, Ravana saw King Marutta performing a sacrifice with the deities.

40020567.author: पदार्थः
40020567.content: संवर्तः Samvarta, नाम named, ब्रह्मर्षिः a Brahmarshi (sage), साक्षात् directly, भ्राता brother, बृहस्पतेः of Brihaspati, याजयामास officiated (the sacrifice), धर्मज्ञः knower of dharma, सर्वैः all, देवगणैः hosts of gods, वृतः surrounded by.

40020567.author: Translation
40020567.content: The righteous Brahmarshi named Samvarta, who was the direct brother of Brihaspati, officiated the sacrifice, surrounded by all the hosts of gods.

40020568.author: पदार्थः
40020568.content: दृष्ट्वा having seen, देवाः the gods, तु indeed, तत् that, रक्षः demon, वरदानेन by the boon, दुर्जयम् unconquerable, तिर्यग्योनिं animal forms, समाविष्टाः entered, तस्य his, दर्शनभीरवः fearful of the sight.

40020568.author: Translation
40020568.content: The gods, fearful of the sight of that demon who was unconquerable due to a boon, assumed animal forms.

40020569.author: पदार्थः
40020569.content: इन्द्रो Indra, मयूरः a peacock, संवृत्तो became, धर्मराजस्तु Dharma-raja (Yama) and, वायसः a crow, कृकलासो a chameleon, धनाध्यक्षो the lord of wealth (Kubera), हंसश्च a swan and, वरुणो Varuna, ऽभवत् became

40020569.author: Translation
40020569.content: Indra transformed into a peacock, Yama into a crow, Kubera into a chameleon, and Varuna into a swan.

40020570.author: पदार्थः
40020570.content: अन्येष्वपि even among others, गतेष्वेवं having gone thus, देवेषु among the gods, अरिनिषूदन O destroyer of enemies, रावणः Ravana, प्राविशत् entered, यज्ञं the sacrifice, सारमेय a dog, इव like, अशुचिः impure

40020570.author: Translation
40020570.content: O destroyer of enemies, while other gods had also transformed and departed, Ravana entered the sacrifice like an impure dog.

40020571.author: पदार्थः
40020571.content: तं him, च and, राजानम् the king, आसाद्य having approached, रावणो Ravana, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of Rakshasas, प्राह said, युद्धं battle, प्रयच्छेति give (me), निर्जितो conquered, ऽस्मीति I am, वा or, वद say

40020571.author: Translation
40020571.content: And having approached that king, Ravana, the lord of Rakshasas, said, "Either give me battle, or declare that I am conquered."

40020572.author: पदार्थः
40020572.content: ततो then, मरुत्तो Marutta, नृपतिः the king, को who, भवान् are you, इति thus, उवाच said, तम् to him, अपहासं a scornful laugh, ततो then, मुक्त्वा having let out, रावणो Ravana, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke

40020572.author: Translation
40020572.content: Then King Marutta asked him, "Who are you?", whereupon Ravana, letting out a scornful laugh, spoke these words.

40020573.author: पदार्थः
40020573.content: अकुतूहलभावेन by your lack of curiosity, प्रीतो pleased, ऽस्मि I am, तव your, पार्थिव O king, धनदस्य of Kubera, अनुजं the younger brother, यो who, मां me, न not, अवगच्छसि you recognize, रावणम् Ravana

40020573.author: Translation
40020573.content: Ravana said, "O king, I am pleased by your lack of curiosity, as you do not recognize me, Ravana, the younger brother of Kubera."

40020574.author: पदार्थः
40020574.content: त्रिषु in three, लोकेषु worlds, कः who, अन्यः other, अस्ति is, यः who, न not, जानाति knows, मे my, बलम् strength, भ्रातरम् brother, येन by whom, निर्जित्य having conquered, विमानम् aerial chariot, इदम् this, आहृतम् was brought, ततः then, मरुत्तः Marutta, सः that, नृपः king, तम् to him, रावणम् to Ravana, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40020574.author: Translation
40020574.content: Ravana boasts, "Who in the three worlds does not know my strength, by which I conquered my brother and brought this aerial chariot?"; then King Marutta spoke to Ravana.

40020575.author: पदार्थः
40020575.content: धन्यः blessed, खलु indeed, भवान् you, येन by whom, ज्येष्ठः elder, भ्राता brother, रणे in battle, जितः was conquered, न not, त्वया by you, सदृशः similar, श्लाध्यः praiseworthy, त्रिषु in three, लोकेषु worlds, विद्यते exists.

40020575.author: Translation
40020575.content: Marutta sarcastically remarks, "Indeed, you are blessed, by whom the elder brother was conquered in battle; there is no one praiseworthy like you in the three worlds."

40020576.author: पदार्थः
40020576.content: न not, अधर्मसहितम् associated with unrighteousness, श्लाध्यम् praiseworthy, तत् that, लोकम् people, प्रतिसंहितम् connected to, कर्म act, दौरात्म्यकम् wicked, कृत्वा having done, श्लाघ्यसे you boast, भ्रातृनिर्जयात् from conquering a brother.

40020576.author: Translation
40020576.content: Marutta continues, "An act associated with unrighteousness is not praiseworthy among people; having performed such a wicked deed, you boast about conquering your brother."

40020577.author: पदार्थः
40020577.content: क how, त्वम् you, प्राक् formerly, केवलम् only, धर्मम् righteousness, चरित्वा having practiced, लब्धवान् obtained, वरम् boon, श्रूतपूर्वं heard before, हि indeed, न not, मया by me, भाषसे you speak, यादृशम् such as, स्वयम् yourself.

40020577.author: Translation
40020577.content: Marutta questions, "How did you, who formerly practiced only righteousness, obtain a boon? Indeed, I have never heard you speak such words as you now utter."

40020578.author: पदार्थः
40020578.content: तिष्ठ stop, इदानीम् now, न not, मे from me, जीवन् living, प्रतियास्यसि you will return, दुर्मते O evil-minded one, अद्य today, त्वाम् you, निशितैः sharp, बाणैः with arrows, प्रेषयामि I send, यमक्षयम् to Yama's abode.

40020578.author: Translation
40020578.content: Marutta declares, "Stop now, O evil-minded one, you will not return alive from me; today I will send you to Yama's abode with sharp arrows."

40020579.author: पदार्थः
40020579.content: ततः then, शरासनं bow, गृह्य having taken, सायकांश्च and arrows, नराधिपः the king, रणाय for battle, निर्ययौ went forth, क्रुद्धः enraged, संवर्तो Samvarta, मार्गम् the path, आवृणोत् blocked.

40020579.author: Translation
40020579.content: Then, the enraged King Marutta, having taken his bow and arrows, went forth for battle, but the sage Samvarta blocked his path.

40020580.author: पदार्थः
40020580.content: सः he, अब्रवीत् spoke, स्नेहसंयुक्तं affectionately, मरुत्तं to Marutta, तं that, महानृषिः great sage, श्रोतव्यं should be heard, यदि if, मद्वाक्यं my words, सम्प्रहारो battle, न not, ते for you, क्षमः suitable.

40020580.author: Translation
40020580.content: That great sage Samvarta affectionately spoke to Marutta, saying that if his words were to be heard, then battle was not suitable for him.

40020581.author: पदार्थः
40020581.content: इदं this, माहेश्वरम् सत्रम् sacrifice dedicated to Maheshvara, असमाप्तम् if left unfinished, कुलं the lineage, दहेत् would consume.

40020581.author: Translation
40020581.content: This sacrifice dedicated to Maheshvara, if left unfinished, would consume the whole lineage.

40020582.author: पदार्थः
40020582.content: दीक्षितस्य for one who is consecrated, कुतो whence, युद्धं battle, क्रोधित्वं anger, दीक्षिते in one who is consecrated, कुतः whence, संशयश्च and doubt, जये in victory, नित्यं always, राक्षसश्च and the demon, सुदुर्जयः very difficult to conquer.

40020582.author: Translation
40020582.content: For one consecrated for a sacrifice, whence comes battle, and whence comes anger; moreover, there is always doubt in victory, and the demon is very difficult to conquer.

40020583.author: पदार्थः
40020583.content: सः he, निवृत्तो turned back, गुरोर्वाक्यात् from the guru's words, मरुत्तः Marutta, पृथिवीपतिः the king, विसृज्य having abandoned, सशरं with arrows, चापं the bow, स्वस्थो composed, मखमुखो intent on the sacrifice, अभवत् became.

40020583.author: Translation
40020583.content: Following his guru's words, King Marutta turned back, abandoned his bow and arrows, and became composed and intent on his sacrifice.

40020584.author: पदार्थः
40020584.content: ततः then, तं him, निर्जितं defeated, मत्वा having considered, घोषयामास announced, वै indeed, शुकः Shuka, रावणो Ravana, जयति is victorious, इति thus, उच्चैः loudly, हर्षात् from joy, नादं a proclamation, विमुक्तवान् uttered.

40020584.author: Translation
40020584.content: Then, Shuka, considering Marutta defeated, loudly proclaimed with joy, "Ravana is victorious!"

40020585.author: पदार्थः
40020585.content: तान् them, भक्षयित्वा having devoured, तत्रस्थान् who were there, महर्षीन् great sages, यज्ञम् to the sacrifice, आगतान् who had come, वितृप्तः fully satisfied, रुधिरैः with the blood, तेषाम् of them, पुनः again, सम्प्रययौ he went, महीम् to the earth.

40020585.author: Translation
40020585.content: Having devoured those great sages who had come to the sacrifice and were there, and being fully satisfied with their blood, he again went to the earth.

40020586.author: पदार्थः
40020586.content: रावणे when Ravana, तु indeed, गते had gone, देवाः the gods, सेन्द्राः with Indra, च and, एव indeed, दिवौकसः the dwellers of heaven, ततः then, स्वाम् their own, योनिम् form, आसाद्य having attained, तानि to those, सत्त्वानि beings, च and, अब्रुवन् they spoke.

40020586.author: Translation
40020586.content: When Ravana had indeed gone, the gods, along with Indra and other dwellers of heaven, then regained their own forms and spoke to those beings.

40020587.author: पदार्थः
40020587.content: हर्षात् from joy, तदा then, अब्रवीत् spoke, इन्द्रः Indra, मयूरम् to the peacock, नीलबर्हिणम् with blue feathers, प्रीतः pleased, अस्मि I am, तव with you, धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma, भुजङ्गात् from serpents, हि indeed, न not, ते to you, भयम् fear.

40020587.author: Translation
40020587.content: Then, from joy, Indra spoke to the blue-feathered peacock, saying, "O knower of dharma, I am pleased with you, and indeed, you shall have no fear from serpents."

40020588.author: पदार्थः
40020588.content: इदम् this, नेत्रसहस्रम् thousand eyes, तु indeed, यत् which, त्वद्बर्हे on your tail-feathers, भविष्यति will be, वर्षमाणे while raining, मयि by me, मुदम् joy, प्राप्स्यसे you will obtain, प्रीतिलक्षणाम् marked by pleasure, एवम् thus, इन्द्रः Indra, वरम् a boon, प्रादात् gave, मयूरस्य to the peacock, सुरेश्वरः the lord of gods.

40020588.author: Translation
40020588.content: Indra, the lord of gods, thus granted a boon to the peacock, saying that the thousand eyes would appear on its tail-feathers, and it would experience joy, a sign of pleasure, when he (Indra) rained.

40020589.author: पदार्थः
40020589.content: नीलाः blue, किल it is said, पुरा formerly, बर्हाः feathers, मयूराणाम् of peacocks, नराधिप O king of men, सुराधिपात् from the lord of gods, वरम् a boon, प्राप्य having obtained, गताः they became, सर्वे all, अपि even, बर्हिणः peacocks.

40020589.author: Translation
40020589.content: O king of men, it is said that formerly the feathers of peacocks were blue, and having obtained a boon from the lord of gods, all peacocks became (as they are now, with the characteristic 'eyes' on their feathers).

40020590.author: पदार्थः
40020590.content: धर्मराजो Dharmaraja, अब्रवीत् said, राम O Rama, प्राग्वंशे in the eastern part of the house, वायसं to the crow, स्थितम् situated, पक्षिंस्तवास्मि O bird, I am, सुप्रीतः very pleased, प्रीतस्य of the pleased one, वचनं words, शृणु listen.

40020590.author: Translation
40020590.content: Dharmaraja (Yama) addressed the crow, who was formerly Rama, situated in the eastern part of the house, saying, "O bird, I am very pleased with you; listen to the words of one who is pleased."

40020591.author: पदार्थः
40020591.content: यथा just as, अन्ये others, विविधै by various, रोगैः diseases, पीड्यन्ते are tormented, प्राणिनो living beings, मया by me, ते those (diseases), न not, ते you (will affect), प्रभविष्यन्ति will be powerful over, मयि when I am, प्रीते pleased, न not, संशयः doubt.

40020591.author: Translation
40020591.content: Just as other living beings are tormented by various diseases through me, those diseases will not affect you when I am pleased, of this there is no doubt.

40020592.author: पदार्थः
40020592.content: मृत्युतः from death, ते to you, भयं fear, न नास्ति is not, वरान्मम from my boon, विहङ्गम O bird, यावत्त्वां as long as you, न not, वधिष्यन्ति will kill, नराः humans, तावत् so long, भविष्यसि you will be.

40020592.author: Translation
40020592.content: O bird, you have no fear of death due to my boon; you will continue to exist as long as humans do not kill you.

40020593.author: पदार्थः
40020593.content: एते these, मद्विषयस्था situated in my realm, वै indeed, मानवाः humans, क्षुद्भयार्दिताः afflicted by the fear of hunger, त्वयि when you, भुक्ते are eaten, तु indeed, तृप्तास्ते satisfied they, भविष्यन्ति will be, सबान्धवाः with their relatives.

40020593.author: Translation
40020593.content: Indeed, these humans in my realm, afflicted by the fear of hunger, will become satisfied along with their relatives when you are eaten.

40020594.author: पदार्थः
40020594.content: वरुणः Varuna, तु then, अब्रवीत् said, हंसं to the swan, गङ्गातोयविहारिणम् sporting in the waters of Ganga, श्रूयतां let it be heard, प्रीतिसंयुक्तं filled with affection, वचः words, पत्ररथेश्वर O lord of birds.

40020594.author: Translation
40020594.content: Then Varuna spoke to the swan, who was sporting in the waters of the Ganga, saying, "O lord of birds, listen to these words filled with affection."

40020595.author: पदार्थः
40020595.content: वर्णो color, मनोहरः charming, सौम्यः gentle, चन्द्रमण्डलसन्निभः resembling the disc of the moon, भविष्यति will be, तव your, उदग्रः excellent, शुद्धफेनसमप्रभः having the luster of pure foam.

40020595.author: Translation
40020595.content: Your complexion will be charming, gentle, resembling the moon's disc, excellent, and will possess the luster of pure foam.

40020596.author: पदार्थः
40020596.content: मच्छरीरं my body, समासाद्य having obtained, कान्तः beautiful, नित्यं always, भविष्यसि you will be, प्राप्स्यसे you will obtain, च and, अतुलां incomparable, प्रीतिं joy, एतत् this, मे my, प्रीतिलक्षणम् sign of affection.

40020596.author: Translation
40020596.content: By obtaining my body, you will always be beautiful and will attain incomparable joy, for this is a sign of my favor.

40020597.author: पदार्थः
40020597.content: हंसानां of swans, हि indeed, पुरा formerly, राम O Rama, नीलवर्णः blue-colored, सपाण्डुरः with a whitish tinge, पक्षाः wings, नीलाग्रसंवीताः covered with blue tips, क्रोडाः breasts, शष्पाग्रनिर्मलाः pure like the tips of fresh grass.

40020597.author: Translation
40020597.content: Indeed, O Rama, in the past, swans were blue-colored with a whitish tinge, their wings were covered with blue tips, and their breasts were pure like the tips of fresh grass.

40020598.author: पदार्थः
40020598.content: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, वैश्रवणः Vaishravana, कृकलासं to the chameleon, गिरौ on the mountain, स्थितम् situated, हैरण्यं golden, सम्प्रयच्छामि I bestow, वर्णं color, प्रीतः pleased, तव to you, अपि also, अहम् I.

40020598.author: Translation
40020598.content: Then Vaishravana, pleased, spoke to the chameleon situated on the mountain, saying, "I bestow upon you a golden color."

40020599.author: पदार्थः
40020599.content: सद्रव्यं with wealth, च and, शिरो head, नित्यं always, भविष्यति will be, तव your, अक्षयम् inexhaustible, एष this, काञ्चनकः golden, वर्णः color, मत्प्रीत्या by my favor, ते for you, भविष्यति will be.

40020599.author: Translation
40020599.content: Your head will always be rich and inexhaustible, and this golden color will be yours by my favor.

40020600.author: पदार्थः
40020600.content: एवं thus, दत्त्वा having given, वरान् boons, तेभ्यः to them, तस्मिन् in that, यज्ञोत्सवे sacrificial festival, सुराः the gods, निवृत्ताः having departed, सह with, राज्ञा the king, ते they, पुनः again, स्वभवनं to their own abodes, गताः went.

40020600.author: Translation
40020600.content: After granting boons to them during that sacrificial festival, the gods, along with the king, returned to their respective abodes. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टादशः सर्गः ।। 18 ।। Thus ends the eighteenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
